title: 전직대통령 예우에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:5:3:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5-3 (Support for Grave Management)
Where a former President has died and has not been buried in a national cemetery, personnel and expenses necessary for managing the grave may be provided as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
